relationship_to_v0.3: Independent external validation. No PushT transition outcomes were inspected when choosing this design.

environment.source_status: Official Hugging Face Gymnasium PushT package adapted from Diffusion Policy.

primary_question: On an externally defined contact-dynamics environment, does weak nonlinear local-action excitation degrade prediction on common intervention actions disproportionately more than it degrades behavior-weighted on-policy prediction when state distributions and raw local-action covariance are matched?
primary_endpoint: mean paired log[(CF_MSE_low/CF_MSE_high)/(factual_MSE_low/factual_MSE_high)] across independent anchor-state replicates
primary_success_rule: Lower bound of the paired-bootstrap 95% CI for mean log amplification must exceed log(2).
secondary_rule: Lower bound of the paired-bootstrap 95% CI for mean log(CF_MSE_low/CF_MSE_high) must exceed log(1.5).

action_parameterization.meaning: local offset from the reset state's agent position to the PushT absolute target-position action
action_parameterization.low_block_counts: 1 copy of each of four diagonal corners and 15 copies of each of four sqrt(2)-scaled axis offsets
action_parameterization.high_block_counts: 16 copies of each of four diagonal corners
action_parameterization.moment_property: Within every 64-state assignment block: E[offset]=0 and Cov(offset)=40^2 I exactly; Var(dx*dy) differs by 16x.

state_control.method: Both conditions use the exact same ordered anchor seeds. Each transition starts from env.reset(seed=anchor_seed); no policy rollout generates anchor states.
state_control.action_assignment: Offsets are randomized within consecutive 64-anchor blocks, whose state sets are identical across low/high conditions and whose offset mean/covariance are exactly matched within each block.

anchor_filter.note: Filter uses reset geometry only; it does not inspect contact counts, rewards, next states, or model errors.

replicate_seed_rule: Replicate r in [0,11] scans candidate anchor seeds starting at 1000000 + 100000*r and uses the first eligible anchors in ascending seed order.
counterfactual_actions: All four diagonal local offsets (+/-40,+/-40), one transition per action per held-out counterfactual anchor.

representation.input: [agent_x/512, agent_y/512, block_x/512, block_y/512, sin(theta), cos(theta), dx/(sqrt(2)*40), dy/(sqrt(2)*40)]
representation.reason: Targets the externally evolving object rather than trivially predictable controlled-agent kinematics; all normalizations use fixed environment ranges.

model.selection: No PushT hyperparameter tuning. Capacity and optimizer settings inherited from the v0.3 factual-only DEV winner.

model_seed_rule: low/high models in replicate r use the same initialization/minibatch seed 60001+r

dataset_seed_rule.anchor_states: common deterministic seed scan per replicate before action assignment

evaluation.factual: MSE of normalized one-step block transition on common held-out anchor states paired with each condition's own matched-moment behavior offsets
evaluation.counterfactual: MSE on the identical held-out anchor/action transitions for both models: all four diagonal corner offsets

bootstrap.method: paired percentile bootstrap across the 12 complete external replicates

integrity_checks: Repeated reset with the same anchor seed reproduces the identical initial observation before data collection.
All absolute target-position actions remain inside [0,512]^2; clipping is forbidden.
Low/high anchor-seed arrays are identical within training and factual evaluation splits.
Every 64-anchor action-assignment block has exactly matched low/high raw offset mean and covariance.
No anchor is selected using post-action outcomes.
nonclaims: No claim that PushT dynamics literally depend on the scalar feature dx*dy.
No claim of universal external validity from one benchmark.
No tuning of offset scale, geometry filter, architecture, or thresholds after PushT outcomes are observed.
A failed external result will be reported as a boundary on the controlled finding.
